meta.title: Morrri
meta.description: Online booking for businesses that run on appointments.

hero.title: Online booking your business and your team will both love.
hero.subtitle: Give every team member their own schedule and services, keep client contact details private, and manage it all from one place.
hero.imageAlt: Mona, the Morrri cat, as a hair stylist with scissors

about.title: What {product} is
about.body: {product} is booking software for appointment-based businesses in the United States, from barbers and nail studios to spas, tutors and clinics. A business signs up, adds its team, services and opening hours, and gets a booking page of its own at <url>morrri.com/your-business</url> to share with clients. Clients book on that page (no account needed) and the business manages the day from one calendar.
about.notASalon: We sell software to businesses. We are not the business you book with, and we do not take a cut of a booking.

page.title: A page per business
page.body: Your team, your services, your prices and your hours, at an address you can print on a card.

calendar.title: One calendar
calendar.body: Your whole team on one screen, with double bookings caught before they happen and walk-ins added by hand.

clients.title: Clients you keep
clients.body: Visit history, notes and tags stay with your business, and clients message you without either side swapping phone numbers.

features.title: One place for the whole working day

reminders.title: Appointment reminders
reminders.body: Every booking gets a confirmation by email straight away, and a reminder before the appointment. A client who gives a mobile number while booking can also tick a box to get that reminder as a text message: appointment reminders only, never marketing, and never without asking. The whole program, including the exact wording of the opt-in, is set out at <link>morrri.com/sms</link>.
